title: horsfieldia subtilis var. rostrata

The therapeutic actions of Horsfieldia subtilis var. rostrata include its ability to act as an immunomodulator, anti-histamine, and anti-convulsant, making it useful in treating conditions such as fever, allergic reactions, and epilepsy.
